+"""
+Debug script to understand the meta structure.
+"""
+import os
+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+# Configure Django settings
+settings.configure(
+    DATABASES={
+        'default': {
+            'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
+            'NAME': ':memory:',
+        }
+    },
+    INSTALLED_APPS=[
+        'django.contrib.contenttypes',
+        'django.contrib.auth',
+    ],
+    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
+)
+
+django.setup()
+
+from django.db import models, connection
+
+# Define models
+class Item(models.Model):
+    uid = models.AutoField(primary_key=True, editable=False)
+    f = models.BooleanField(default=False)
+
+    def reset(self):
+        self.uid = None
+        self.f = False
+
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+class Derived(Item):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+# Create tables
+with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
+    schema_editor.create_model(Item)
+    schema_editor.create_model(Derived)
+
+print("=== Item meta ===")
+print(f"Item._meta.pk: {Item._meta.pk}")
+print(f"Item._meta.pk.attname: {Item._meta.pk.attname}")
+print(f"Item._meta.pk.name: {Item._meta.pk.name}")
+print(f"Item._meta.parents: {Item._meta.parents}")
+
+print("\n=== Derived meta ===")
+print(f"Derived._meta.pk: {Derived._meta.pk}")
+print(f"Derived._meta.pk.attname: {Derived._meta.pk.attname}")
+print(f"Derived._meta.pk.name: {Derived._meta.pk.name}")
+print(f"Derived._meta.parents: {Derived._meta.parents}")
+
+for parent, field in Derived._meta.parents.items():
+    print(f"\n  parent: {parent}")
+    print(f"  field: {field}")
+    if field:
+        print(f"  field.attname: {field.attname}")
+        print(f"  field.name: {field.name}")
+        print(f"  parent._meta.pk: {parent._meta.pk}")
+        print(f"  parent._meta.pk.attname: {parent._meta.pk.attname}")
+
+# Create an object and check
+derived = Derived.objects.create(f=True)
+print(f"\n=== After creating Derived(f=True) ===")
+print(f"derived.pk: {derived.pk}")
+print(f"derived.uid: {derived.uid}")
+print(f"derived.item_ptr_id: {derived.item_ptr_id}")
+print(f"derived._meta.pk.attname: {derived._meta.pk.attname}")
+
+# Get item and derived
+item = Item.objects.get(pk=derived.pk)
+obj1 = item.derived
+print(f"\n=== obj1 (from item.derived) ===")
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")
+
+# Reset
+obj1.reset()
+print(f"\n=== After obj1.reset() ===")
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")
+print(f"obj1._state.adding: {obj1._state.adding}")
+
+# What does _get_pk_val return for Item?
+print(f"\nobj1._get_pk_val(Item._meta): {obj1._get_pk_val(Item._meta)}")
+print(f"obj1._get_pk_val(Derived._meta): {obj1._get_pk_val(Derived._meta)}")

+"""
+Debug script to understand the meta structure more.
+"""
+import os
+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+# Configure Django settings
+settings.configure(
+    DATABASES={
+        'default': {
+            'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
+            'NAME': ':memory:',
+        }
+    },
+    INSTALLED_APPS=[
+        'django.contrib.contenttypes',
+        'django.contrib.auth',
+    ],
+    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
+)
+
+django.setup()
+
+from django.db import models, connection
+
+# Define models
+class Item(models.Model):
+    uid = models.AutoField(primary_key=True, editable=False)
+    f = models.BooleanField(default=False)
+
+    def reset(self):
+        self.uid = None
+        self.f = False
+
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+class Derived(Item):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+# Create tables
+with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
+    schema_editor.create_model(Item)
+    schema_editor.create_model(Derived)
+
+# Create an object and check
+derived = Derived.objects.create(f=True)
+
+# Get item and derived
+item = Item.objects.get(pk=derived.pk)
+obj1 = item.derived
+
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")
+
+# What happens when we set pk = None?
+print("\n--- Setting obj1.pk = None ---")
+obj1.pk = None
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")
+
+# Reset
+obj1 = item.derived
+print("\n--- Setting obj1.uid = None ---")
+obj1.uid = None
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")
+
+# What is the pk of Derived?
+print(f"\nDerived._meta.pk: {Derived._meta.pk}")
+print(f"Derived._meta.pk.attname: {Derived._meta.pk.attname}")
+print(f"Item._meta.pk: {Item._meta.pk}")
+print(f"Item._meta.pk.attname: {Item._meta.pk.attname}")
+
+# So when we set obj1.uid = None, we're setting the Item's pk to None
+# But Derived's pk (item_ptr_id) is still 1
+# The _save_parents method then restores uid from item_ptr_id
+
+# The fix should be: when the pk of the child is None (item_ptr_id is None),
+# we should NOT restore the parent pk from the link field.
+# OR: when the user sets uid = None, we should also set item_ptr_id = None.
+
+# Let's check what happens when we set item_ptr_id = None
+obj1 = item.derived
+print("\n--- Setting obj1.item_ptr_id = None ---")
+obj1.item_ptr_id = None
+print(f"obj1.pk: {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid: {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1.item_ptr_id: {obj1.item_ptr_id}")

+"""
+Reproduction script for the bug: Resetting primary key for a child model doesn't work.
+"""
+import os
+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+# Configure Django settings
+settings.configure(
+    DATABASES={
+        'default': {
+            'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
+            'NAME': ':memory:',
+        }
+    },
+    INSTALLED_APPS=[
+        'django.contrib.contenttypes',
+        'django.contrib.auth',
+    ],
+    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
+)
+
+django.setup()
+
+from django.db import models, connection
+from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment
+
+setup_test_environment()
+
+# Define models
+class Item(models.Model):
+    uid = models.AutoField(primary_key=True, editable=False)
+    f = models.BooleanField(default=False)
+
+    def reset(self):
+        self.uid = None
+        self.f = False
+
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+class Derived(Item):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'reproduce'
+
+
+# Create tables
+with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
+    schema_editor.create_model(Item)
+    schema_editor.create_model(Derived)
+
+print("Tables created successfully")
+
+# Test the bug
+print("\n--- Testing the bug ---")
+
+# Create the first object
+derived = Derived.objects.create(f=True)
+print(f"Created Derived object with pk={derived.pk}, f={derived.f}")
+
+# Get the item and its derived instance
+item = Item.objects.get(pk=derived.pk)
+obj1 = item.derived
+print(f"Got derived from item: pk={obj1.pk}, f={obj1.f}")
+
+# Reset the object
+obj1.reset()
+print(f"After reset: pk={obj1.pk}, f={obj1.f}")
+
+# Save - this should create a NEW object, not overwrite the existing one
+obj1.save()
+print(f"After save: pk={obj1.pk}, f={obj1.f}")
+
+# Check if the original object still has f=True
+try:
+    original = Item.objects.get(pk=derived.pk)
+    print(f"Original object (pk={derived.pk}): f={original.f}")
+    if original.f:
+        print("SUCCESS: Original object still has f=True")
+    else:
+        print("FAILURE: Original object was overwritten! f=False")
+except Item.DoesNotExist:
+    print(f"Original object (pk={derived.pk}) was deleted!")
+
+# Count total objects
+total_items = Item.objects.count()
+total_derived = Derived.objects.count()
+print(f"\nTotal Item objects: {total_items}")
+print(f"Total Derived objects: {total_derived}")
+
+if total_items == 2 and total_derived == 2:
+    print("SUCCESS: Two separate objects exist")
+else:
+    print(f"FAILURE: Expected 2 objects of each type, got {total_items} Items and {total_derived} Derived")
+
+print("\n--- Debugging the issue ---")
+print(f"derived.pk = {derived.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.pk = {obj1.pk}")
+print(f"obj1.uid = {obj1.uid}")
+print(f"obj1._meta.pk.attname = {obj1._meta.pk.attname}")
+
+# Let's also check what happens with the parent pk
+print(f"\nobj1._meta.parents = {obj1._meta.parents}")
+for parent, field in obj1._meta.parents.items():
+    print(f"  parent: {parent}, field: {field}")
+    if field:
+        print(f"  field.attname: {field.attname}")
+        print(f"  getattr(obj1, field.attname): {getattr(obj1, field.attname)}")
+        print(f"  getattr(obj1, parent._meta.pk.attname): {getattr(obj1, parent._meta.pk.attname)}")
